errors.evidence: The model name on the x-axis is "Claude 3.5 Sonnet", not "Claude 3 Sonnet".
The model name on the x-axis is "Gemini Flash 1.5", not "Gemini 1.5".
The models on the x-axis are not listed alphabetically; they are sorted roughly in ascending order of their performance score.
The y-axis labels range from 60 to 90. While the data goes up to 91.8, stating a specific upper limit of 92 is an unsupported interpretation.

errors.text_span: For each model, two bars are presented side-by-side
errors.evidence: The chart is a simple bar chart, not a grouped bar chart. Each model on the x-axis corresponds to only one bar.

errors.text_span: one light blue representing the “Small model” and one dark blue representing the “Large model.”
errors.evidence: The legend is reversed. The legend shows that light blue bars represent the 'Large model' and dark blue bars represent the 'Small model'.
The error bars are only shown extending above the top of each bar, not below.

errors.text_span: The “Small model” bar for Llama-3.3 70B Instruct reaches approximately 66.4, while the corresponding “Large model” reaches 74.8.
errors.evidence: This is entirely incorrect. Llama-3.3 70B Instruct is a single 'Large model' (light blue bar) with a score of 66.4. The score 74.8 belongs to a different model, 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet'. The description incorrectly assumes a grouped bar structure and misattributes data.

errors.text_span: The “Small model” bar for Phi-4 reaches approximately 91.8 and the corresponding “Large model” bar reaches approximately 89.8.
errors.evidence: This is entirely incorrect. Phi-4 is a single 'Small model' (dark blue bar) with a score of 91.8. The score 89.8 belongs to a different model, 'Gemini Pro 1.5'. The description incorrectly assumes a grouped bar structure and misattributes data.

errors.text_span: all bars and error bars are displayed in black
errors.evidence: The bars are not black; they are light blue and dark blue. Only the error bars are black.
